method: One unique file + axe rule + element target is one occurrence, not one independent root cause. Shared CSS/template causes intentionally fix many occurrences together. Only file/rule groups with zero remaining failures are counted. Desktop baseline and final audit use the same production scripts, markup and local copies of canonical Formwheel assets. Third-party requests are blocked.
exclusions: Cross-project redirects: instagram/, threads/, x/, youtube/ (destination markup not counted).
secret/creator.html: sandbox iframe prevented full automatic audit; only icon/skip-link markup changed and syntax/link gates passed.
Meta-refresh forwarding pages and archived/backup content.
Firebase login/live writes, emulator tests, external project repositories and nondefault themes are outside this audit.
